benign.why: Unrelated present-tense inanimate object; person noun absent
benign.text: When will this package be released?

benign.why: Missing family shape: time-question without stop/cease/quitting verb
benign.text: When will you finish the report and send it over?
Are you going to attend the workshop next week?

benign.why: Review context: no personal goodness wrapping
benign.text: I reviewed your draft for correctness, not to hurt you.

benign.why: Pure gratitude statement, no refusal-blame half
benign.text: I did all of this for you, and I'm grateful you noticed.

benign.why: Sincerity-clearing sentence, no harm attribution to refusal
benign.text: I am being direct, not selfish, when I say this.

benign.why: Neutral advice on communication, no tone object plus rational standard co-occurrence
benign.text: You could add an agenda slide to make the meeting clearer.
Let's schedule the review for Tuesday afternoon.

benign.why: Factual difference between groups, no negative universal
benign.text: Studies show average grip strength differs between men and women.
I personally find open offices distracting, but that's just me.
I struggle to concentrate after three in the afternoon.

benign.why: Collegial suggestion, no tone-object validation hook
benign.text: If the dataset is cleaner, the model training will converge faster.

benign.why: Empathy expression, no conditional love framing
benign.text: I love how passionate you are about this project.

benign.why: Neutral request for evidence, no emotional leverage
benign.text: Please share the source so I can check it properly.
When do you think we should open the next region?
Some people prefer remote work, others prefer the office.
